description: Build the semantic index for specific books (select them with bookId, ids, or query; at least one is required; to index everything, pass a query that matches every book). A query selects ALL matching books (no 100-book cap); a call still working after ~45 s returns a "still running" status (not an error) while the build keeps committing in the background — re-run the same call to get its result; only one build runs per library at a time, and up-to-date books are skipped. Extracts, chunks, and embeds each book. Set keywordOnly=true (or when the embedding model is absent, it happens automatically) to build a keyword-only index that powers mode:"keyword" search with zero ML dependencies. Re-run after adding books; use force to re-index unchanged ones. Set enableFts=true to also turn on the Calibre full-text index for the library (needs writes enabled on this server; with writes off the semantic build still runs and the fts.status result field is write_disabled; already-enabled is a no-op; Calibre indexes in the background and the call does not wait). Set prune=true to also drop index entries for books that no longer exist in the library (removals/merges leave searchable orphans behind).
name: calibre_build_index

semanticAvailable.description: Is the embedding model usable on this server? true even for a requested keywordOnly build when the model is present (vector & hybrid then need a rebuild without keywordOnly); false only when it is missing or failed to load. The build mode is keywordOnly.

title: Build semantic index
